title: Any Organisation (Generic) product catalogue, version 2
sourceDescription: Version 2, checked 25 November 2026. It corrects the Workday mapping from Digital & Technology to the HR capabilities it actually serves, adds customer-contact and case-tracking links to the CRM entries, adds strategy and risk links to Planview, corrects the Miro claim and mapping, and adds reviewed-candidate products for the main corporate gaps. Every new or changed claim is Pending review until a named reviewer signs it. Coverage is a first slice, not an exhaustive market survey.
